idea-plugin.name: Air Pets
idea-plugin.description:
Keep an eye on your Air agents without opening the Air tool window. Air Pets gives each session an animated companion in IntelliJ IDEA. Pets move while agents work, ask for attention when input is needed, and celebrate a result.

  • See session activity: badges and animations distinguish working, waiting, review, resting, completed, and error states.
  • Reply from a pet: click to open Quick Chat with Air's native conversation and reply composer, or open the full session in Air. Unsupported sessions offer the full Air view instead.
  • Check the details: hover for the session name, workspace, and worktree branch. Optionally show Air-reported cost in USD and working time observed while the project is open, not the session's historical duration.
  • Clear completed sessions: use a completed pet's badge or hover card to mark it done with Air's archive action. This does not stop an agent or approve a review.
  • Control the overlay: drag pets aside, turn off animation, hide names, or hide pets. Empty space around them passes clicks through to the IDE.

Companions include cats, dogs, Clippy, Kodee, Runzo, snakes, and rubber ducks. Species are assigned automatically. The overlay shows up to 12 pets from the current project and its worktrees; the status-bar menu gives access to all discovered sessions.

Try it: choose Tools → Air Pets → Air Pets Demo Mode to explore fictional sessions without running an agent. Click Pets in the status bar or right-click a pet for preferences.
